macro.overnight_read: The dollar stayed strong (Dollar Index 123.6) and most major forex pairs are in a downtrend except USD_JPY, USD_CAD and USD_CHF which show slight upside. Crypto is in extreme fear (FG 13) with low RSI, suggesting a potential rebound but high risk. Expect a cautious open with safe‑haven bias ahead of the November 25 data releases.
macro.summary: Yield curve is barely positive and VIX is elevated, so the market leans defensive. Keep the core swing‑trade allocation modest and focus on safe‑haven currencies while avoiding volatile crypto. Trade short‑term momentum and mean‑reversion setups around the upcoming GDP, durable‑goods and inflation numbers. Stay ready to cut losers fast if data triggers a sell‑off.
